steps.title: Upload CSV and configure OT‑2
steps.instruction: Download the provided CSV template, fill it with headers and rows that specify source labware, destination labware, source well, destination well, aspiration height (from the bottom of the well), volume to transfer, and the deck slot for each labware; then in the Opentrons app upload this CSV, select the pipette model, choose the pipette mount (left or right), specify the tip type (filter or non‑filter), set the tip‑usage strategy (new tip for each transfer or reuse the same tip), and finally download the generated Python protocol for the OT‑2.

substeps.instruction: Download the CSV template from the provided link.
Enter data with required headers (source labware, destination labware, source well, destination well, aspiration height, volume, slot).
Upload the completed CSV in the Opentrons app.
Specify tip type (filter or not) and tip usage strategy (new tip each transfer or reuse).
Download the Python protocol generated by the app.

steps.title: Load labware and tips on OT‑2
steps.instruction: Place the source and destination labware in the deck slots indicated in the CSV, load the chosen tip rack of the specified tip type, and mount the selected pipette on the designated side of the robot.

steps.title: Aspirate specified volume
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, the robot aspirates the user‑specified volume from the source well of the indicated labware at the designated aspiration height from the bottom of the well.

steps.title: Dispense volume into destination well
steps.instruction: Immediately after aspiration, the robot dispenses the same volume into the destination well of the indicated labware, using the slot information from the CSV.

steps.title: Repeat for all transfers
steps.instruction: The robot repeats the aspirate and dispense steps for every line in the CSV until all transfers are completed.
